title: I am still stoked by a commitment to owning data and portability. Still, give @medium mad points on that front. In fact when I downloaded all my posts
summary: I am still stoked by a commitment to owning data and portability. Still, give @medium mad points on that front. In fact when I downloaded all my posts they even had proper microformats so importing to my site was super easy. Still I had hopes Medium would help redefine the web
author: Greg McVerry
